3315679.title: File:Halibut with mango salsa on coconut brown rice (434662467).jpg

ObjectName.value: Halibut with mango salsa on coconut brown rice (434662467)

Categories.value: Coconut rice|Zucchini-based food|Flickr images reviewed by File Upload Bot (Magnus Manske)|Rice as a side dish|Canada photographs taken on 2007-03-25|Squash-based food|March 2007 in Vancouver|Halibut dishes|Brown rice-based food|Food in Vancouver|Mango salsa

ImageDescription.value:
It is the start of Halibut season. Erin came up with the idea for this dish.

Made the rice in chicken stock with a few handfuls of dried shredded coconut (had no cream for some reason).

Seasoned the Halibut with soy sauce, rolled it in some panko then tossed it in a hot pan. Browned it off for about a minute each side then tossed the pan (with fish) into a 350 oven for 5-8 min.

Diced up two mangoes, a chili and a handful of cilantro then tossed them in a bowl. Added a tablespoon of sweet chili sauce and a splash of soy.

Some pan-fried zucchini discs on the plate. A carrot, cilantro and lettuce salad dressed with sesame vinaigrette not shown.

(I gotta get a couple lil flashes and learn how to photograph food properly. The overhead light here made this look kinda greasy.)

Credit.value: Halibut with mango salsa on coconut brown rice

172399110.title: File:Shaomai and Dubaorou in Inner Mongolia.jpg

ObjectName.value: Shaomai and Dubaorou in Inner Mongolia

ImageDescription.value:
​Hohhot shaomai features a flavorful filling of minced mutton, scallion, and ginger, creating a dense, aromatic, and slightly spicy taste. The greasy dumplings are typically served with vinegar and tea, and are steamed or pan-fried, forming a distinctive flower-shaped top.
Another dish is  Dubaorou(肚包肉). Dubaorou is a specialty lamb dish from China's Inner Mongolia and northwestern regions. It involves wrapping fresh lamb meat inside a lamb's stomach, which is then tied shut with string and cooked. Traditionally considered elaborate to prepare, it was typically served only when hosting guests.

Artist.value: Phlins Chen
